nphi.title: CSIRO/ACDP partnership program under Partnerships for a Healthy Region
nphi.actor: CSIRO Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness (ACDP)
nphi.with: Animal health laboratories in Southeast Asia; Pacific field diagnostic networks
nphi.type: Programme (DFAT Partnerships for a Healthy Region)
nphi.summary: AUD 24.2m CSIRO program (over AUD 12m via ACDP) strengthening animal health laboratories in Southeast Asia, testing at high-risk sites such as wildlife markets and boosting Pacific field diagnostic networks.

nphi.title: eLABorate – laboratory accuracy and biosafety for outbreak response (DFAT Strategic Partnership)
nphi.with: National public health laboratories of Fiji, Solomon Islands, Vanuatu and Kiribati
nphi.type: Project (DFAT Partnerships for a Healthy Region)
nphi.summary: VIDRL-led work area of the Doherty–DFAT Strategic Partnership (2024–2027) training Pacific national labs to expand molecular and serological testing with quality assurance and management.

nphi.title: HiT3 – Hepatitis B integration into Triple Elimination
nphi.actor: Doherty Institute (VIDRL / WHO CC for Viral Hepatitis)
nphi.with: Ministries of health of Vanuatu, Solomon Islands, Cambodia and Fiji
nphi.type: Project (DFAT Partnerships for a Healthy Region)
nphi.summary: Technical support under the Doherty–DFAT Strategic Partnership to integrate hepatitis B into triple-elimination programmes for mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B.

nphi.title: Pac-EVIPP+ – Pacific Evidence for Informed Policies and Programs Plus
nphi.with: Pacific Community (SPC); Fiji National University; SAFETYNET; ASEAN+3 FETN; ministries of health
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded AU$7.5 million programme (2024–2028) to build the applied field epidemiology workforce in Pacific Island countries, Cambodia and Laos through advanced FETP pathways, mentorship and communities of practice.

nphi.title: Doherty Institute Strategic Partnership for Prevention, Surveillance and Response to Infectious Diseases across the Indo-Pacific
nphi.with: In-country university and laboratory partners (not individually named); Nossal Institute provides GEDSI/WASH expertise
nphi.summary: A four-year DFAT-funded partnership under Partnerships for a Healthy Region that builds workforce, laboratory and genomic surveillance capacity, AMR capacity and data for decision-making in Southeast Asia and the Pacific.

nphi.title: AIHW–SPC data for decision-making partnership in Pacific countries
nphi.actor: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW)
nphi.summary: Under Partnerships for a Healthy Region, AIHW works with SPC to strengthen health data and its use for decision-making in five Pacific Island countries.

nphi.title: Fiji Pathogen Genomics Laboratory
nphi.with: Doherty Institute (MDU PHL, VIDRL, WHO CC for AMR); Australia DFAT; Pacific Community (SPC); WHO
nphi.summary: Fiji CDC launched its national pathogen genomics lab in Suva in May 2025 with support from the Doherty Institute's public health labs, DFAT, SPC and WHO (sequencing equipment, mentorship and training).

nphi.title: Pacific Public Health Surveillance Network (PPHSN) – LabNet, EpiNet, PacNet, PICNet
nphi.actor: Pacific Community (SPC) – Pacific Public Health Surveillance Network (PPHSN)
nphi.with: Health ministries of Pacific Island countries and territories; WHO; US CDC; ESR/PHF Science; Fiji National University; PIHOA; regional reference laboratories
nphi.summary: Regional surveillance network set up in 1996 under SPC and WHO, with a three-tier laboratory network (regional level-2 labs in Fiji, French Polynesia, Guam and New Caledonia; reference labs in Australia, New Zealand and the US), outbreak…

nphi.title: NCIRS support to middle-income countries on NITAGs and immunisation provider education
nphi.actor: National Centre for Immunisation Research and Surveillance (NCIRS)
nphi.with: Ministries of health; national immunisation technical advisory groups; Sydney Vietnam Institute; Gavi
nphi.summary: Gavi-funded two-year project in which NCIRS supports NITAG strengthening, including twinning between advisory groups, and builds country-led immunisation training in Fiji, Timor-Leste and Viet Nam.

nphi.title: Pacific Islands NITAG Support Project
nphi.actor: National Centre for Immunisation Research and Surveillance (NCIRS)
nphi.with: WHO Division of Pacific Technical Support; University of Sydney; 15 Pacific Island countries and areas; Wellcome
nphi.summary: Wellcome-funded NCIRS work with WHO Pacific to understand and strengthen vaccine policy decision-making in Pacific Island countries, including an inter-regional workshop in Nadi in February 2024.

nphi.title: FNU Communicable Diseases Research Centre with University of Otago support
nphi.actor: Fiji National University (College of Medicine, Nursing and Health Sciences)
nphi.with: University of Otago Global Health Institute; Mercy Hospital Dunedin
nphi.summary: Communicable Diseases Research Centre set up in 2021 within FNU's Fiji Institute of Pacific Health Research, backed by Otago's Global Health Institute under a 2017 MoU and a funded research fellow post.

nphi.title: COMBAT-AMR – mitigating antimicrobial resistance in Pacific Island countries
nphi.with: Burnet Institute; Pacific Pathology Training Centre; Pacific Regional Infectious Diseases Association; WHO CC for AMR surveillance; DFAT Indo-Pacific Centre for Health Security
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded One Health AMR programme covering infection prevention and control, antimicrobial stewardship, laboratory surveillance and animal health surveillance in four Pacific countries.

nphi.title: Lab-based influenza surveillance in Pacific Island countries (PPHSN)
nphi.actor: Institut Pasteur de Nouvelle-Calédonie (with Pacific Community)
nphi.with: Pacific Community (SPC); WHO National Influenza Centre at ESR; WHO CC for Influenza Melbourne; US CDC; Cook Islands, Guam, Wallis and Futuna
nphi.summary: US CDC-funded project from 2006 to set up laboratory-based influenza surveillance in Pacific Island countries, with confirmatory PCR at Institut Pasteur de Nouvelle-Calédonie and training at ESR and the Melbourne WHO collaborating centre.

nphi.title: Drinking-water safety planning training and policy support in the Pacific (WHO/SOPAC)
nphi.actor: ESR (Institute of Environmental Science and Research, now PHF Science)
nphi.with: WHO South Pacific; SPC-SOPAC; DASS-NC; Cook Islands
nphi.summary: ESR delivered drinking-water safety planning workshops for Pacific countries from 2006 and helped draft Fiji's national drinking water safety plan for rural and island communities under WHO–SOPAC contracts.

nphi.title: WHO National Influenza Centre support to Pacific laboratories
nphi.actor: ESR (Institute of Environmental Science and Research, now PHF Science)
nphi.with: SPC; WHO; Cook Islands, Guam, Niue, Tokelau, Wallis and Futuna, American Samoa
nphi.summary: As WHO National Influenza Centre, ESR provided influenza laboratory training, reference testing and sentinel surveillance support to Pacific island laboratories in 2006, 2009 and 2010.

nphi.title: Three Plagues – typhoid, dengue and leptospirosis in Fiji
nphi.with: Fiji Ministry of Health and Medical Services; Fiji National University; Edith Cowan University; WHO
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded grant (AU$2.01 million) developing mobile tools for water, sanitation and catchment management and training cross-sectoral outbreak teams against climate-sensitive infections in Fiji.
